Energy

Summary of who wasted the most energy and who cost the enemy the most energy.
Calculated by adding up Losses (and Stalemates, Defends, Escapes, Interrupts) and Defends, the multiplying the number by 25.
E_Wasted means the member spent X energy on attacks that failed.
E_Stolen means X energy was wasted by the enemy on attacking the member unsuccessfully.
You might want to take a closer look at members with high E_Wasted values and remind them to pick fights they can win!

AI summary (BETA)

This is an experimental portion of the report - an overview of the war generated by AI.
When looking at this section, keep that in mind and take the results with a grain of salt.
Before taking any actions that might impact faction members mentioned in this summary, double-check that there are no mistakes or missed key details.

Here is a summary of the combat data provided:

Overall Faction Performance

The faction demonstrates a reasonably good performance overall. A large proportion of members have non-zero war hits, indicating active participation. The faction also has a good proportion of members with a positive Net_Score, meaning that more members gained score than lost. E_Wasted values seem reasonable. A number of members had great performance with high war hits, activity, and fair fight scores.

Areas for Improvement

  1. Target Selection: Some members exhibit high Lost counts, indicating poor target selection or difficulty in securing hits.
  2. Reduce E_Wasted: While not excessively high overall, there's room to improve efficiency in attacks to reduce wasted energy.

Individual Highlights: Positive

  • Merle-DicksIn: Demonstrated high activity (3.942 hours), and War_Hits (133), resulting in a high Net_Score (482.12). They also had a retaliate.
  • ScatterBean: Displayed a very high activity (8.612 hours), and War_Hits (107) and net score (406.53).
  • Benedicc: Had a good score (332.91), and a high War_Hits (107).
  • RipleyWolf: Showed high activity (9.116 hours) and a high Net_Score (436.76).

Individual Highlights: Negative

  • Happymeal: Had a very low FairFight score (1.77), high E_Wasted (100), and negative Net_Score (-17.67).
  • FogBorne: Had a very low FairFight score (1.07), and a negative Net_Score (-64.73).
  • MrLuther: Had zero hits and a negative net score.

Additional Observations

  • Chapelle: Stands out with a high Lost count (17) compared to their War_Hits (33), indicating potential issues with target selection.
